findings.failureScenario: The legacy egui UiState serializes `language` as a Locale code (en, zh-hans, zh-hant, ja, pt-br, es, de, ru, fr, uk). migrateLegacyUi only accepts the hard-coded subset ['en','zh-hans','zh-hant','ja']. A user who chose Portuguese (Brasil) in the egui app, which the React UI also supports (normalizeLocale maps pt-* to pt-br), loses that choice on migration and falls back to English. The migration contract drifted from the Rust Locale serialization it reads.
findings.action: Migrate legacy.language with normalizeLocale(legacy.language) when it maps to a supported LocaleCode, instead of a fixed list. Add a migration test for a pt-br legacy ui.json.
